thread:
ellie-sales: FYI — Solaris Inc POC provisioning stuck. Dedicated pool request in asia-southeast2 is pending; deployer returned a 403 quota error. Customer requires APAC-only. Need quick triage. :grimacing:

omar-ps: Pool id solaris-pool-77. Deployer log: 
```
HTTP 403 Forbidden
{"error":"quota_exceeded","msg":"No GPUs available in asia-southeast2 for project solaris-poc"}
```

jia-eng: Sounds like a regional quota + SKU shortage. What was the requested SKU/AZ settings?

ellie-sales: They requested a100-80gb x2 with az_affinity=true for latency isolation. Their security team demanded single-AZ for the POC data flows.

sam-ops: Confirmed: orchestrator refuses auto-downgrade when az_affinity is true. infra inventory shows 0 a100 free in that region. We have a few a40s.

infra-bot: EVENT: provisioning_attempt solaris-pool-77 queued at 2026-03-22T09:13:09Z. Provider quotas: a100-80gb:0, a40:6. Auto-fallback disabled due to az_affinity flag.

omar-ps: Options: (A) request quota increase (est 1-8h), (B) offer quantized model on a40 in-region (performance note required), (C) manual rebind from infra reserve (needs product-ops signoff), (D) short-term cross-region route (APAC->us-west2) if customer allows.

jia-eng: I can whip up a 1-page perf appendix comparing a100 vs a40 quantized latency and throughput within 30m. Short summary: quantized on a40 meets functional parity for demo but not peak throughput.

ellie-sales: Solaris legal likely won't accept cross-region. I'll ask if they can relax single-AZ to same-region multi-AZ. Meanwhile, please start quota raise and product-ops ping.

sam-ops: Opening quota ticket now. Ticket GCP-55899 created. ETA 1-6h. Also pinging product-ops for reserve rebind permission.

infra-bot: ACTION: quota_increase_request submitted (GCP-55899).

omar-ps: For support repro paste this payload and the cloud error: 
```
{
  "project": "solaris-poc",
  "region": "asia-southeast2",
  "sku": "a100-80gb",
  "az_affinity": true,
  "count": 2
}
```

jia-eng: Orchestrator logs to include: 
```
2026-03-22T09:13:09Z orchestrator: start_provision solaris-pool-77
2026-03-22T09:13:41Z cloudapi:error quota_exceeded a100-80gb
2026-03-22T09:13:41Z orchestrator: halt reason=quota_exceeded
```

ellie-sales: Also Solaris asked about short-term pricing for a 21-day reserved POC and whether SKU substitution is allowed. We have a template?

sam-ops: Use POC pricing snippet: 21-day reserved, pro-rata billing, one allowed SKU substitution with notice and performance appendix; we can offer a one-time migration credit if we have to swap hardware mid-POC.

mike-oncall: product-ops approved temporary rebind of 1x a100 from infra-reserve-apac (priority exception). I can bind now and leave the remaining replica pending while quota request finishes. Rebind will take ~8 minutes.

infra-bot: NOTE: manual_rebind started: solaris-pool-77 <- infra-reserve-apac at 2026-03-22T09:20:10Z

mike-oncall: Bound 1x a100 to solaris-pool-77. Pool status: partial_bound (1/2). Informing customer and offering quantized a40 option for second replica if they want fully in-region immediately.

ellie-sales: Solaris accepted partial bind for demo and asked for the perf appendix for decision on second replica. I'm sending the sales note now with pricing and options. Thanks team. Closing immediate blocker; follow-up: add runbook note about az_affinity + scarcity warnings. :white_check_mark:
